beats.say: Strictly gets sweaty! BBC says Melanie C leads the fitness routine.
BBC says Jamie Miller makes his UK TV debut performing Babydoll alongside four Strictly Pros.
BBC notes Delta Goodrem returns after a week-long injury break to join the ballroom on Saturday.
The fitness set is powered by Spacedust's Gym and Tonic, Meghan Trainor's Shimmer and Melanie C's own track Sweat.
BBC adds Melanie C is the sportiest Spice Girl, bringing extra energy to the routine.
Which Strictly moment will everyone be talking about this week?
